text:
aisha: FYI vendor called — partial manifest for our Q3 reserved racks is stuck at port. ETA changed to +10 days for ~40% of units. This will hit the APAC Dedicated rollouts and marketplace preloads.

mike: ouch. which vendor / PO? any serials held?

aisha: vendor = NovaRack, PO = PO-981275, reserved sku = NR-GPU-A100X. Held at customs for docs. No serial list yet, they said container-level hold.

leon: tag @sylvia — we have upstream commitments tied to that PO for two SI pilots next week. Need to know if we should pause the pilot go-live.

sylvia: seeing the same PO in our reservation ledger. If 40% delivered late, that drops burst capacity for Dedicated customers by ~22% in ap-southeast1. We should flag any queued customer launches.

jordan: marketplace manifest shows the shipment as "in transit" until vendor updates. We can mark listings as "delayed" but that breaks the go-live announcement. What's the plan?

sam: can we borrow capacity from the EU pool temporarily (cross-region burst)? Cost + network egress but keeps SLA for customers.

leon: cross-region is doable for short window but needs partner consent (network egress + compliance). Also affects latency-sensitive SLAs.

aisha: vendor offered a partial customs release: they can prioritize 12 racks out of 30 in the container for immediate pickup (est +3 days) if we sign an expedited handling addendum and cover brokerage fees.

mike: what's the delta on brokerage + expedite? ballpark numbers.

aisha: vendor estimates $18k for expedited clearance + $2k one-time handling. Total ~ $20k for 12 racks.

sylvia: compare that to cost of customer credits / missed launch SLA. If two enterprise customers delay, credits could exceed $20k. I lean to expedite.

jordan: announcement-wise, if we take partial release we can ship a soft-lift for the SI pilot and keep marketplace listing as "available with limited capacity". Not perfect but better than an outright delay.

leon: action items: 1) procurement ok on $20k? 2) legal to sign addendum? 3) ops to prepare cross-region fallback if expedite fails.

sam: procurement: we can eat $20k from contingency if ops confirms cross-region fallback in the meantime. Ops: can you validate capacity transfer lead time?

orion-bot: Vendor update: NovaRack container CNTR-4598 status changed to HOLD-CUSTOMS at 2026-03-20T14:22Z. Partial release offer noted. Case ID VR-33211.

mike: thanks bot. procurement — please confirm fund source by EOD. Legal pinged on addendum. Ops please estimate cross-region churn and latency impact table.

sylvia: also loop in Customer Success for proactive messaging to affected Dedicated customers and the SI. We should prepare a standard outage + mitigation note.

aisha: CS notified. Draft msg in #customer-success/dedicated: 
```
Heads-up: due to a partner customs delay, small subset of reserved racks will follow a staggered delivery. We expect partial delivery in ~3 days for prioritized units; full fulfillment in ~10 days. We will provide temporary cross-region capacity or credits as needed. Contact your CSM for specifics.
```

jordan: if procurement approves expedite, marketplace ops: mark SKU as "limited availability" + add ETA note. I'll hold the joint announcement until we confirm the 12-rack partial release.

leon: ops estimate: cross-region transfer can be provisioned within 6 hours for GPU allocation re-routing, but performance-sensitive routes (low-latency inference) may see 20-40ms extra p95. I'll add a short rollout playbook.

sam: procurement confirmed contingency spend OK up to $25k. Legal cleared the addendum except signature. Go for expedited handling.

aisha: signing now. vendor asked for PO amendment and expedite fee payment ref #VR-33211. I'll update once payment confirmed.

mike: once partial release confirmed, we need a comms plan: 1) private note to affected customers 2) update marketplace listing 3) delay joint press if SI pilot impacted. Who owns each?

sylvia: CS owns (1). jordan owns (2). product marketing holds (3) with me for escalation.

orion-bot: Payment confirmed: Expedite fee $20,000 posted to vendor invoice INV-77812 at 2026-03-20T18:05Z.

aisha: vendor says pickup scheduled in +2 days now (was +3). I'll update once we have serials.

leon: good. ops — prep the fallback scripts and a staging route to test cross-region replication for the SI pilot tonight.

sam: ops ack. will run a smoke test at 22:00 PST.

jordan: holding announcement until we see serials and verify 12 racks allocated. We can do a limited joint announcement if SI confirms pilot path.

sylvia: thanks everyone. closing loop: expedite approved, partial release expected +2 days, full manifest +10 days. CS and product-marketing standing by.

mike: nice triage — shoutout to procurement and ops for moving fast :thumbsup:
